integrity_notes: Complete integral proof and finite reproducibility code included. No claim of exhaustive worldwide novelty; independent audit outstanding.
scientific_limitations: Applies to ordinary integral singular cohomology of complex matrix-pencil Schubert surfaces, not intersection cohomology or Chow groups.
The result does not classify the varieties up to homeomorphism or isomorphism.
Published rational pairing and blow-up construction used as inputs; independent validation not performed.
title: Integral cohomology lattices of Schubert compactifications of matrix pencils
